ai_content.desc_ar: استمتع بمشاهدة مسلسل أساطير أبيكس مترجم بجودة عالية.
ai_content.desc_en: Master an ever-growing roster of legendary characters with powerful abilities and experience strategic squad play and innovative gameplay in the next evolution of Hero Shooter and Battle Royale. Apex Legends is a continuous challenge in terms of efficiency and improvement, where you can acquire new abilities, enhance your skills, and strengthen your team. With new innovations in gameplay, Apex Legends is an exciting and rewarding experience.
